zh.title: 房屋维护与装修：季节清单、Permit 和查承包商执照
zh.seo_title: 加州房屋维护与装修指南｜陈靖
zh.description: 湾区房主一年四季的维护重点，装修前如何判断 permit、用 CSLB 查承包商执照，以及合同、付款和 lien 上要注意的规则，帮你避开日后卖房才暴露的问题。
zh.lead: 很多大修都是小问题拖出来的，很多卖房时的麻烦来自当年没拉 permit。这篇先讲日常维护，再讲动工前该查什么。

en.title: Home Maintenance and Renovation: Seasons, Permits and Contractors
en.seo_title: Bay Area Home Maintenance & Renovation | Jing Chen
en.description: A seasonal upkeep checklist for Bay Area homes, plus how to handle permits, verify a CSLB license, structure payments and protect against liens.
en.lead: Big repairs often start as small ones left alone, and many problems at resale trace back to work done without a permit. Here is how to stay ahead of both.
